title: W1 rectangle transcript (v1.0)
description: Shape contract for W1 argument-principle rectangle transcripts. Normative semantics, checker checks C1-C11, and the two displayed hypotheses live in FORMAT.md (same directory). This schema enforces SHAPE only: a schema-valid file can still be checker-rejected. All integers are decimal strings (JSON native numbers are forbidden for checked data).

trust_label.description: Fixed honest label, enforced per function by the allOf/if blocks below.

rect.description: R = [sigma1, sigma2] x [T1, T2]; checker C2 verifies 1/2 < sigma1 <= sigma2 < 1 and T1 < T2 by integer cross-multiplication.

scales.description: K: value scale (lo <= K*Re f <= hi etc.); A: argument scale in TURN units (argLo <= A*(Delta/2pi) <= argHi).

claimed_m.description: Claimed winding number m >= 0; checker C9 pins it (S_lo <= A*m <= S_hi), C10 ties it to mode.

mesh.description: Boundary mesh, counterclockwise from the bottom-left corner. Each edge stores its VARYING coordinate only: bottom/top are Re-value lists, right/left are Im-value lists. Traversal: bottom increasing sigma1->sigma2, right increasing T1->T2, top DECREASING sigma2->sigma1, left DECREASING T2->T1. Endpoints included; corners appear as last-of-one-edge and first-of-the-next (checker C3).

segments.description: One row per boundary segment, in global traversal order (bottom segments, then right, top, left). Count must equal sum over edges of (breakpoints - 1) (checker C4).

modulus_floor.description: OPTIONAL global boundary-modulus floor claim |f| >= Fn/Fd on all of dR; checker C11 verifies (mre^2+mim^2)*Fd^2 >= Fn^2*K^2 per segment.

producer.description: UNTRUSTED provenance metadata (implementation, version, precision, subdivision policy, timestamps). Required by the two-producer bookkeeping, never checked.

trust_label.const: kernel-checked modulo displayed hypotheses H-ENCL and H-AP (producers untrusted)
checker-level only (D-R8): format-checked modulo H-ENCL for f_DH; no Lean-backed conclusion

intStr.description: Arbitrary-precision integer as a decimal string.

rat.description: Exact rational n/d, d > 0 syntactically; need not be reduced.

row.description: Per-segment rows: value box (reLo<=K*Re f<=reHi, imLo<=K*Im f<=imHi, for ALL s on the closed segment) and argument-increment enclosure in turn units (argLo<=A*(Delta/2pi)<=argHi).
